entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hey, Sis.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: You just got back from your trip and[n]you're already studying? How diligent.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I have souvenirs for you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...The principal of Shujin Academy[n]has passed away.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: He suddenly stopped while crossing[n]the road and was struck by a large[n]vehicle. Death by external trauma.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: They say suicide seems to be a strong[n]possibility...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Principal Kobayakawa committed[n]suicide!?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: But would someone about to kill[n]themselves try to go to the police[n]station?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: He even used a taxi to get there.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you mean... this might be another[n]incident?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Even if he had a sudden shift in his state[n]of mind... it's still unnatural.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I can only suspect that he had a "change[n]of heart."

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are you saying he was targeted by the[n]Phantom Thieves!?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But that's impossible!

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: How are you so certain?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: W-Well...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In prior cases, the changes of heart[n]seemed to be done to make people[n]confess their crimes.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It's hard to explain, but this incident[n]seems contradictory to their usual[n]modus operandi...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Did Principal Kobayakawa seem any[n]different to you lately?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I don't really know. He rarely contacted[n]the students, after all...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Could something have happened during[n]the school trip?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Ah, you're studying. I'm sorry to[n]bother you.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Makoto.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hm?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Never mind. It's nothing.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Just don't get dragged into trouble, okay?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: This is bad... I'd better tell the others...
